name: glubler
description: Search, save, and organize websites into Glubler collections from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Glubler connects ChatGPT directly to your Glubler account so you can search, save, and organize websites into curated collections using simple natural language prompts.

With the Glubler plugin, you can:
- Search Glubler's catalog: quickly find registered websites, tools, gaming hubs, and news sources already indexed in the Glubler database.
- Create and manage collections: organize your favorite resources into custom Glubler lists and structured subglublers straight from your conversation.
- Collect and glue websites: ask ChatGPT to save individual sites or entire batches of links to your profile. If a suggested website isn't in Glubler yet, Glubler automatically fetches its metadata, retrieves the authentic favicon, and checks it against quality standards.
- Organize and rename: update collection titles, customize URL slugs, and remove links whenever you want to tidy up your lists.

Whether you're compiling research sources, curating design inspiration, or building a reading list, Glubler keeps your web discoveries neatly organized and accessible anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Find websites in the Glubler catalog about design inspiration.
Save these links into a new Glubler collection for me.
Show my Glubler collections and their links.

positive.description: Create a Glubler (website list) for streaming services and save three streaming sites into it.
positive.prompt: Create a Glubler (website list) with Streaming Services like netflix.com, disneyplus.com, hulu.com.
positive.expected_behavior: First calls create_glubler with the title "Streaming Services" and reports that the new collection was created, including its glublerId. Then calls glue_websites_batch once with that glublerId and the three URLs netflix.com, disneyplus.com and hulu.com in a single urls array. The batch response reports addedCount: 3 with the three URLs and their titles. The three sites are fetched websites: for any site that is not already in the Glubler catalog, Glubler retrieves the page metadata and the real favicon and adds it to the collection. The assistant does not call glue_website separately for each URL, and does not claim a site was saved unless the tool reports it in added.

Calls list_my_glublers and returns the JSON payload with a total count and a glublers array. Each entry carries the collection's title, slugName, itemCount, subglublerCount and nestingLevel. The assistant lists the collections it received and does not add collections that are not in the returned array.

positive.description: Create a collection and batch-save three news sites into it.
positive.prompt: Create a new Glubler collection called 'AI News' and add: techcrunch.com, theverge.com, wired.com
positive.expected_behavior: First calls create_glubler with the title "AI News" and reports the new collection, including its glublerId and slugName. Then calls glue_websites_batch once with that glublerId and the three URLs techcrunch.com, theverge.com and wired.com in a single urls array. The batch response reports addedCount: 3 and an added array with those three URLs and their fetched titles. The assistant does not call glue_website separately for each URL, and does not report a site as added unless the tool lists it in added.

positive.description: Rename a collection and change its URL slug.
positive.prompt: Rename my collection 'AI News' to 'Tech News Daily'
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the 'AI News' collection with list_my_glublers, then calls rename_glubler with that collection's glublerId, the new title "Tech News Daily" and slugName "tech-news-daily". The response reports success: true together with the updated title and slugName. The assistant confirms the new title and slug accurately.

positive.description: Show everything inside one of the user's collections.
positive.prompt: Show me everything inside my 'Tech News Daily' Glubler
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the 'Tech News Daily' collection with list_my_glublers, then calls get_glubler_details with its glublerId. The response carries the collection's title and slugName, an items array in which each entry holds a website object (url, title, id, glueCount, likeCount, commentCount) and a gluedAt timestamp, and a subGlublers array. The assistant reports the collection's title, slugName, its saved websites and any subglublers, and does not invent websites that are not in the returned items array.

negative.description: General web browsing or opening a URL outside Glubler. The plugin has no browsing tool, so no Glubler tool should be called. The assistant should explain that it cannot open or read arbitrary pages and cannot browse the web.

Saving a bookmark in another application. The prompt does not mention Glubler and the plugin only manages Glubler collections, so no Glubler tool should be called. The assistant should say the plugin only saves to Glubler collections and ask the user to name a Glubler collection.
negative.prompt: Save this article to my bookmarks so I can read it later

negative.description: Sharing to a social network. The plugin has no social posting tools, so no Glubler tool should be called. The assistant should explain that it cannot post to social networks and, at most, offer to copy the list into the conversation.
negative.prompt: Post my list of favorite cooking websites to Twitter

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds a reviewer-ready demo recording and demo account, rewrites the review cases around Glubler collections, and drops the brand color to match the required contrast against white.
